summary: A shared limiter budget couples tenants on the same route and window. The first tenant consumes it; immediate 429 retries amplify database session reads. Pool capacity is a coincident deployment, with no queue or connection errors in the controls.

rejectedHypotheses.reason: The post-deployment single-tenant control remains healthy; peak use is below capacity, queue and connection errors remain zero. Reversing tenant order reverses the victim.

limitations: Deterministic in-memory sequential replay only; no real database, network transport, distributed clock or simultaneous-thread race was exercised.
